name: Carmagist
description:
About This Game

🏰 Lead a Ruined World Back to Life

In a world devastated by the Demon Lord, you become the leader of a collapsing nation. 

Advance Technology, gather Funds, grow your Population — and defeat the Demon Lord.

⚙️ The Balance of Tech, Funds, and Population Is Everything

To develop your nation, build Facilities and raise your core resources — Tech, Funds, and Population. 

What you prioritize will shape your nation’s fate. 

• Tech Points: Hitting thresholds unlocks new Technologies and adds cards to the draft pool.

• Funds: The more Funds you have, the more Coins you have each turn to pay card costs.

• Population Points: At thresholds, you can Gain, Upgrade, or Purge cards.

Now — do you invest in Tech, chase Funds, or grow your Population?
Every move can save — or doom — the nation.

🛡️ The Archdemons Draw Near

In each stage, the Archdemons — lieutenants of the Demon Lord — invade.

They steadily close in on your base, intent on annihilating your nation.

Build Facilities or repel the demons? 

A single misstep can doom everything. 

Make the right calls and defeat the Archdemons (or the Demon Lord) to clear the stage.

Your decisions will forge humanity’s future.

🃏 Build Your Strategy with Around 300 Cards

Begin with medieval-style Technologies and magic — Windmill Town, Swordsman, Fireball, Movable Type — and, as you advance Tech, unlock powerful cards like Tank, Explosion, and Railgun.

Whether you fight with a deck focused on Magic attacks, Mid- and Long-Range attacks, or Melee attacks is up to you.

But your enemies are tough.

Demons wield Abilities such as:

• Spellproof — strong against Magic attacks

• Steam — strong against Mid- and Long-Range attacks

• Flying — strong against Melee attacks

Read enemy Abilities, rebuild your deck, and discover the formula for victory!

📺 Streaming Guidelines

• Individuals and organizations may freely stream this game.

• No prior contact or permission is required.

• Monetization is allowed.

• However, please refrain from content that is violent, sexual, discriminatory, hateful, harassing, or unlawful, or that otherwise violates common standards of decency.

Note: These guidelines may change without notice. Streams made after any update must follow the latest version.
short_desc: Civilization vs. the Demon Lord?! Carmagist is a deck-building strategy game set in a ruined world where the Demon Lord has shattered civilization. Lead a nation on the brink of extinction and build up Tech, Funds, and Population to reclaim the future — every choice shapes your nation’s fate.
